# PR #3960: Patch: the daily board holds "End turn automatically" until the mulligan is over, so the other player's keep never fails as stale

Closes #3841

`DailyBoard` now holds the player's saved "End turn automatically" setting (`setAutoEndTurn`, R345) through a daily game's mulligan. The other seat's keep or mulligan no longer fails as `409 stale` because of it. The fix is web-only: no server change, no ruling, no spec file.

## What changed
- **`apps/web/src/daily/DailyBoard.tsx`:** `send` and the held-send effect both hold the setting while `view.phase === "mulligan"`, in addition to the existing "opponent holds the move" and "request in flight" holds. The held action stays in `heldAutoEndTurn.current` and goes out on the first read after the mulligan, with the player holding the move and the setting still differing. I added a paragraph to the header comment saying so.
- **`apps/web/src/daily/DailyBoard.test.tsx`:** one new case, `#3841 End turn automatically waits for the mulligan to be over…`. It renders a mulligan view with `autoEndTurn: false` saved, so the setting differs from the view's. It checks that no POST goes out while the mulligan stands. It then concedes, gets `409 stale`, and the reread returns the post-mulligan game at `seq` 9. Finally it checks that the setting is sent with `after: 9`.

## Tests
- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/daily/DailyBoard.test.tsx` passed 18 of 18. That includes the existing `#3727 End turn automatically waits…` case.
- With `DailyBoard.tsx` reverted and the new test kept, the new case failed and the other 17 passed. I then restored the fix.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` printed nothing but the `tsc` command line, so it is clean.
- `pnpm exec eslint apps/web/src/daily` is clean.
- `cargo fmt --check` passed.
- I did not run `cargo jackioh patches check` or `spec check`. No Rust or spec file changed and no ruling is cited or added, but I have no output to show for them.

## Decisions
- I took the web hold the issue prefers. The alternative, refusing `setAutoEndTurn` during the mulligan in `daily_allows`, changes a rule and would need a ruling note.
- I made no departures from the plan. The mulligan view offered `concede`, so the test needed no `legal` override.
- I added no constant. `"mulligan"` is the engine's `Phase` literal, as in `Game.tsx`.

## For the reviewer
- If the viewer is on a mulligan view but not holding the move, the existing `!hasMove` hold already applies. The new condition only adds the case where both seats hold the move.
- `Game.tsx` sends once per `viewer:value`. The held action survives until sent, so the setting is not lost.

# #3841: Patch: the daily board holds "End turn automatically" until the mulligan is over, so the other player's keep never fails as stale
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

A follow-up to daily games (#3727, merged in #3762), found in its review and left out of it. Part of the tracker #3726.

### What happens

During a daily game's mulligan both players hold the move at once (R3727002). The board sends the player's saved "End turn automatically" setting (`setAutoEndTurn`, R345) as soon as the player holds the move, which in the mulligan is at once. That adds a row to the game's log. If the other player sends their keep or mulligan at the same moment, theirs fails as `409 stale`: the board rereads quietly, and that player has to click again.

- [`apps/web/src/daily/DailyBoard.tsx:101`](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/1964004112/apps/web/src/daily/DailyBoard.tsx#L100-L137): the held `setAutoEndTurn`, sent once `hasMove` is true.
- [`crates/shared/src/host/daily.rs:112`](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/1964004112/crates/shared/src/host/daily.rs#L112) (`daily_holders`): both seats hold the move during the mulligan.

### What should happen

One player's saved setting never makes the other player's mulligan answer fail. The setting still reaches the game in time for the first turn.

### How to reproduce

Two accounts, one with "End turn automatically" set differently from the game's default. Open a fresh daily game's board on both at once; while the first board's `setAutoEndTurn` is in flight, keep the hand on the second. The second's keep answers `409 stale`, and it must click again.

### Fix

In `DailyBoard`, also hold `setAutoEndTurn` until the mulligan is over, then send it as it does now. (The server-side alternative, refusing `setAutoEndTurn` during the mulligan in `daily_allows`, `crates/shared/src/host/daily.rs:176`, changes a rule and would need a ruling note, so prefer the web fix.) Add a `DailyBoard.test.tsx` case that fails without it: during the mulligan the board sends no `setAutoEndTurn`, and sends it once the mulligan is over.

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `claude-6` (claude, `sonnet`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43696378475)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

During a daily game's mulligan, `DailyBoard` sends no `setAutoEndTurn`, so one player's saved setting can no longer make the other player's keep or mulligan answer `409 stale`. Once the mulligan is over (`view.phase !== "mulligan"`), the board sends the held setting exactly as it does now, in time for the first turn. A new `DailyBoard.test.tsx` case fails without the change. The fix is web-only: no server change and no ruling.

## Files to touch

| Path | | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `apps/web/src/daily/DailyBoard.tsx` | change | Hold `setAutoEndTurn` while `view.phase === "mulligan"`, in `send` and in the held-send effect. Update the header comment. |
| `apps/web/src/daily/DailyBoard.test.tsx` | change | Add one `it("#3841 …")` case after the `"#3727 End turn automatically waits for the player's move…"` case. |

**Must not touch:**
- `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/` and `.claude/`.
- `crates/shared/src/host/daily.rs` (`daily_allows`, `daily_holders`) and the rest of `crates/`.
- `apps/web/src/game/Game.tsx`.
- `spec/`: no ruling note or `spec/pending` file is needed, because the web fix changes no rule.

**Governing text:**
- R3727002: both seats hold the move during the mulligan.
- R345: "End turn automatically".
- CLAUDE.md rule 7: the server decides who holds the move; the board only holds back its own optional intent.
- The `DailyBoard.tsx` header comment.

## Steps

1. In `apps/web/src/daily/DailyBoard.tsx`, in `send` (the `useCallback`), change the hold condition to `action.type === "setAutoEndTurn" && (shown === null || !shown.hasMove || shown.view.phase === "mulligan" || sending.current)`. The action is stored in `heldAutoEndTurn.current` and returned, as before.
2. In the same file, in the held-send `useEffect` ("The held 'End turn automatically'…"), add `game.view.phase === "mulligan"` to the early-return condition: `if (held === null || game === null || game.over || !game.hasMove || game.view.phase === "mulligan" || sending.current) return;`. The held value then stays in the ref across reads until the mulligan ends. The effect already re-runs on `[game, sends, send]`, and every answer or reread sets `game`.
3. Do not add a constant: `"mulligan"` is the engine's `Phase` literal, already used in `Game.tsx:161` (`view.phase === "mulligan"`).
4. Update the header comment, the paragraph "End turn automatically (R345)…". Add that the setting is also held through the mulligan (R3727002: both seats hold the move then), so it adds no row to the game's log while the other seat is answering its keep (#3841).
5. In `DailyBoard.test.tsx`, add the test below.

## Tests

`apps/web/src/daily/DailyBoard.test.tsx`: add `it("#3841 End turn automatically waits for the mulligan to be over: none is sent during it, and it is sent once it is", …)`.

- **Setup:**
  - Call `writeSettings({ autoEndTurn: false })`. `baseView()` has `autoEndTurn` undefined, which counts as on, so the setting differs and `Game` asks to send it at once.
  - Keep a `let over = false`.
  - `serve(() => over ? dailyGame({ seq: 9 }) : dailyGame({ view: baseView({ phase: "mulligan" }) }), answer)` uses the same `serve` helper as the sibling test.
- **Reaching the end of the mulligan:** copy the sibling test's pattern.
  - `answer` matches a POST whose action type is `concede`, sets `over = true`, and returns `refusal(409, "stale", "The game moved on.")`.
  - The board then rereads and gets the post-mulligan game.
- **Steps:**
  1. Render `<DailyBoard matchId="g-1" />`.
  2. Click `await screen.findByTestId("concede", undefined, SLOW)`.
  3. Assert `server.to("POST", "/api/daily/games/g-1/actions")` has length 0. The board has the move (`hasMove` true) and the setting differs, so only the new mulligan hold stops the send.
  4. Click `concede-confirm`.
  5. `waitFor` the POST list to reach length 2 (SLOW).
- **Assertions:**
  - `actions[0].action` equals `CONCEDE`.
  - `actions[1]` matches `{ after: 9, action: { type: "setAutoEndTurn", enabled: false } }`.
- **Why it fails without the fix:** the setting would go out before the concede, at `after: 7`, so the length-0 assertion fails.
- **If the mulligan view does not offer `concede`:** the builder may render the mulligan from `dailyGame({ view: baseView({ phase: "mulligan" }), legal: [CONCEDE] })`. If a different trigger is needed, use another action `legal` allows. Keep the shape: assert nothing is sent in the mulligan, then reread to a `phase: "main"` game and assert the setting is sent with `after` equal to that game's `seq`.

**Commands:**
- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/daily/DailyBoard.test.tsx`
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`
- `pnpm exec eslint apps/web/src/daily`

Run the existing `"#3727 End turn automatically waits…"` case in the same file too; it must stay green.

## Done when

- [ ] `DailyBoard` sends no `setAutoEndTurn` during the mulligan.
- [ ] `DailyBoard` sends the held `setAutoEndTurn` once `phase` is no longer `"mulligan"` and the player holds the move.
- [ ] The new `#3841` test passes and fails with the two code edits reverted.
- [ ] All other `DailyBoard.test.tsx` cases pass.
- [ ] Web typecheck and eslint are clean.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check` and the `cargo jackioh patches check` / `spec check` gates are green. No Rust or spec file changed, and no ruling is cited or added.
- [ ] Nothing is added to `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `crates/` or `spec/`.

## Risks

- **Setting lost:** `Game.tsx` sends `setAutoEndTurn` only once per `viewer:value`, through its `autoEndTurnSent` ref. If the board dropped the held action, the setting would never be resent. The change keeps the action in `heldAutoEndTurn.current` until it is sent, as the existing "opponent's move" hold does.
- **Late for the first turn:** the game leaves the mulligan with one seat active. That seat has `hasMove` and sends at once. The other seat sends when its turn begins, as it already does for any turn it does not hold.
- **Mulligan view and the held send:** `view` is the viewer's own `PlayerView`, so `phase` holds no hidden information (rule 7). The board enforces no rule; it only delays a client intent.
- **Server rule untouched:** `daily_allows` still accepts `setAutoEndTurn` during the mulligan, as the issue prefers.

## Open questions

None. By the rule this is medium: it touches one web file plus its test, with no engine, AI, cross-crate or migration change.
<!-- /jackioh-bot:plan -->

# Plan (sonnet, medium)

## Goal

During a daily game's mulligan, `DailyBoard` sends no `setAutoEndTurn`, so one player's saved setting can no longer make the other player's keep or mulligan answer `409 stale`. Once the mulligan is over (`view.phase !== "mulligan"`), the board sends the held setting exactly as it does now, in time for the first turn. A new `DailyBoard.test.tsx` case fails without the change. The fix is web-only: no server change and no ruling.

## Files to touch

| Path | | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `apps/web/src/daily/DailyBoard.tsx` | change | Hold `setAutoEndTurn` while `view.phase === "mulligan"`, in `send` and in the held-send effect. Update the header comment. |
| `apps/web/src/daily/DailyBoard.test.tsx` | change | Add one `it("#3841 …")` case after the `"#3727 End turn automatically waits for the player's move…"` case. |

**Must not touch:**
- `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/` and `.claude/`.
- `crates/shared/src/host/daily.rs` (`daily_allows`, `daily_holders`) and the rest of `crates/`.
- `apps/web/src/game/Game.tsx`.
- `spec/`: no ruling note or `spec/pending` file is needed, because the web fix changes no rule.

**Governing text:**
- R3727002: both seats hold the move during the mulligan.
- R345: "End turn automatically".
- CLAUDE.md rule 7: the server decides who holds the move; the board only holds back its own optional intent.
- The `DailyBoard.tsx` header comment.

## Steps

1. In `apps/web/src/daily/DailyBoard.tsx`, in `send` (the `useCallback`), change the hold condition to `action.type === "setAutoEndTurn" && (shown === null || !shown.hasMove || shown.view.phase === "mulligan" || sending.current)`. The action is stored in `heldAutoEndTurn.current` and returned, as before.
2. In the same file, in the held-send `useEffect` ("The held 'End turn automatically'…"), add `game.view.phase === "mulligan"` to the early-return condition: `if (held === null || game === null || game.over || !game.hasMove || game.view.phase === "mulligan" || sending.current) return;`. The held value then stays in the ref across reads until the mulligan ends. The effect already re-runs on `[game, sends, send]`, and every answer or reread sets `game`.
3. Do not add a constant: `"mulligan"` is the engine's `Phase` literal, already used in `Game.tsx:161` (`view.phase === "mulligan"`).
4. Update the header comment, the paragraph "End turn automatically (R345)…". Add that the setting is also held through the mulligan (R3727002: both seats hold the move then), so it adds no row to the game's log while the other seat is answering its keep (#3841).
5. In `DailyBoard.test.tsx`, add the test below.

## Tests

`apps/web/src/daily/DailyBoard.test.tsx`: add `it("#3841 End turn automatically waits for the mulligan to be over: none is sent during it, and it is sent once it is", …)`.

- **Setup:**
  - Call `writeSettings({ autoEndTurn: false })`. `baseView()` has `autoEndTurn` undefined, which counts as on, so the setting differs and `Game` asks to send it at once.
  - Keep a `let over = false`.
  - `serve(() => over ? dailyGame({ seq: 9 }) : dailyGame({ view: baseView({ phase: "mulligan" }) }), answer)` uses the same `serve` helper as the sibling test.
- **Reaching the end of the mulligan:** copy the sibling test's pattern.
  - `answer` matches a POST whose action type is `concede`, sets `over = true`, and returns `refusal(409, "stale", "The game moved on.")`.
  - The board then rereads and gets the post-mulligan game.
- **Steps:**
  1. Render `<DailyBoard matchId="g-1" />`.
  2. Click `await screen.findByTestId("concede", undefined, SLOW)`.
  3. Assert `server.to("POST", "/api/daily/games/g-1/actions")` has length 0. The board has the move (`hasMove` true) and the setting differs, so only the new mulligan hold stops the send.
  4. Click `concede-confirm`.
  5. `waitFor` the POST list to reach length 2 (SLOW).
- **Assertions:**
  - `actions[0].action` equals `CONCEDE`.
  - `actions[1]` matches `{ after: 9, action: { type: "setAutoEndTurn", enabled: false } }`.
- **Why it fails without the fix:** the setting would go out before the concede, at `after: 7`, so the length-0 assertion fails.
- **If the mulligan view does not offer `concede`:** the builder may render the mulligan from `dailyGame({ view: baseView({ phase: "mulligan" }), legal: [CONCEDE] })`. If a different trigger is needed, use another action `legal` allows. Keep the shape: assert nothing is sent in the mulligan, then reread to a `phase: "main"` game and assert the setting is sent with `after` equal to that game's `seq`.

**Commands:**
- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/daily/DailyBoard.test.tsx`
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`
- `pnpm exec eslint apps/web/src/daily`

Run the existing `"#3727 End turn automatically waits…"` case in the same file too; it must stay green.

## Done when

- [ ] `DailyBoard` sends no `setAutoEndTurn` during the mulligan.
- [ ] `DailyBoard` sends the held `setAutoEndTurn` once `phase` is no longer `"mulligan"` and the player holds the move.
- [ ] The new `#3841` test passes and fails with the two code edits reverted.
- [ ] All other `DailyBoard.test.tsx` cases pass.
- [ ] Web typecheck and eslint are clean.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check` and the `cargo jackioh patches check` / `spec check` gates are green. No Rust or spec file changed, and no ruling is cited or added.
- [ ] Nothing is added to `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `crates/` or `spec/`.

## Risks

- **Setting lost:** `Game.tsx` sends `setAutoEndTurn` only once per `viewer:value`, through its `autoEndTurnSent` ref. If the board dropped the held action, the setting would never be resent. The change keeps the action in `heldAutoEndTurn.current` until it is sent, as the existing "opponent's move" hold does.
- **Late for the first turn:** the game leaves the mulligan with one seat active. That seat has `hasMove` and sends at once. The other seat sends when its turn begins, as it already does for any turn it does not hold.
- **Mulligan view and the held send:** `view` is the viewer's own `PlayerView`, so `phase` holds no hidden information (rule 7). The board enforces no rule; it only delays a client intent.
- **Server rule untouched:** `daily_allows` still accepts `setAutoEndTurn` during the mulligan, as the issue prefers.

## Open questions

None. By the rule this is medium: it touches one web file plus its test, with no engine, AI, cross-crate or migration change.
